Here's a roundup of South Korean news from the past few weeks, based on sources dated up to mid-October 2026.

**Security and North Korea**
- North Korea's ballistic missile activity continues. A South Korean military report said one missile fired from the Pyongyang area flew more than 900 km. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said one of the missiles launched from the Pyongyang area flew more than 900km.
- Seoul's intelligence service has also reported a transfer of missiles from North Korea to Russia. South Korea's NIS reported that North Korea recently transferred ballistic missiles to Russia for the first time in approximately one year.
- A landmine blast in the DMZ injured three South Korean soldiers, and Seoul is demanding an apology while Pyongyang denies planting the mines. A landmine explosion which injured three South Korean soldiers in the Korean Demilitarized Zone last week. S Korea demands apology over DMZ blasts as N Korea denies planting mines. President Lee Jae Myung has avoided blaming Pyongyang directly. President avoids pointing finger at Pyongyang despite results of investigation

**Diplomacy**
- Seoul plans to recall its envoy to Ukraine amid a dispute over prisoners of war. South Korea to recall Ukraine envoy in diplomatic row over POWs

**Economy and US investment**
- Korean markets have been volatile. One Korea Pro analysis describes a Five-day KOSPI sell-off that raises doubts about how long the semiconductor profit boom will last.
- A large investment package with the US was announced. Trump unveils $200bn South Korean investment in US projects, including Alaska LNG, and the Nikkei listing also notes that South Korea to build 8 nuclear power plants in US, invest $120bn.

**Domestic**
- Financial-sector hacking prompted a government response. In response to recent consecutive hacking incidents in the financial sector, Prime Minister Han Sung-sook has ordered a complete overhaul of security systems.
- In Incheon, a shopping centre stabbing injured eight people, and the Justice Ministry has apologised after the suspect met his probation officer hours before the attack. The Justice Ministry has apologised after the Incheon suspect met his probation officer hours before the shopping centre rampage.
- Cabinet nomination disputes are drawing attention to how past presidents have handled them, according to a Korea Pro feature from October 14.

**Space and culture**
- The Nuri rocket was scheduled for its fifth flight, carrying 15 satellites. The early-October coverage I found is older than the rest, so check for an update on whether the launch happened.
- The TV schedule includes several new drama premieres in October, such as Doctor X: Mafia in White | SBS TV | October 9 | November 14 | Ongoing.

Note that some sources in these results have inconsistent dates. For the latest on any of these stories, check Korea Pro, Al Jazeera, Nikkei Asia, or SCMP directly.

이번 주(2026년 10월 12~18일 무렵) 한국의 주요 뉴스를 분야별로 정리했습니다. 검색 결과가 주로 10월 14~18일 보도여서, '셋째 주'를 이 기간으로 보고 정리했습니다.

**경제·증시**
- 반도체와 AI 산업에 대한 기대가 불안으로 바뀌면서 주가가 급락했습니다. 주식시장에서는 반도체와 인공지능 산업에 대한 기대가 불안으로 바뀌며 주가가 급락했다.
- 국제통화기금(IMF)은 연차총회에서 올해 세계 성장률 전망치를 3.1%로 제시했지만, 중동 전쟁과 에너지 가격 상승, 부채, AI 투자 위험을 함께 언급했습니다 (이번 주 태국 방콕에서 열린 국제통화기금(IMF)·세계은행 연차총회에서는 세계 경제의 새로운 위험이 논의됐다. IMF는 2026년 세계 경제성장률 전망치를 3.1%로 제시하면서도).
- 국민연금은 100일 만에 보유 주식에서 182조 원의 손실이 났다는 보도가 나왔습니다 (MBC 보도 제목 기준).

**정치·사법**
- 특검은 '평양 무인기 작전' 관련 윤석열 전 대통령의 2심에서 징역 30년을 구형했습니다 (MBC 타임라인).
- 관저 이전 의혹과 관련해 김대기 전 비서실장과 이상민 전 장관에게 각각 징역 4년, 3년 6개월이 구형됐습니다 (MBC 타임라인).
- 박종준 전 경호처장은 '비화폰 삭제' 사건 2심에서 징역형을 받아 1심 무죄 판단이 뒤집혔습니다 (MBC 타임라인).
- 국민의힘은 신천지 신도의 민주당 집단 가입 정황을 두고 압수수색과 특검을 요구했습니다 (MBC 타임라인).

**사회·안전**
- 인천의 한 복합상가에서 전자발찌를 찬 남성이 흉기를 휘둘러 여러 명이 다쳤습니다 (인천의 한 복합상가에서는 전자발찌를 착용한 남성이 흉기를 휘둘러 여러 시민이 다쳤다.).
- 슈퍼태풍 '참피'가 대만 방향으로 예측되면서 비상이 걸렸다는 보도가 있었습니다 (MBC 뉴스).

**정책·행정**
- 금융위원회와 법무부 등 44개 기관, 9,929명이 내년부터 세종으로 본격 이전합니다 (정책브리핑 실시간 인기뉴스).
- 정부는 연말까지 수도권에서 21만 8,000~23만 5,000호 이상의 주택을 착공하겠다는 계획을 내놓았습니다 (정책브리핑).
- 한국은 세계관광발전지수에서 1계단 오른 12위를 기록했습니다 (정책브리핑 인기뉴스).

**외교·안보**
- 중동 전쟁에 대한 한국군의 역할 확대 여부가 새로운 쟁점으로 떠올랐습니다 (이번 주 외교·안보 분야에서는 한국군의 중동 작전 확대 가능성이 새로운 쟁점으로 떠올랐다.).
- 브런슨 주한미군 사령관 측의 'DMZ 남쪽 철책선' 발언을 두고 논란이 일었고, 국방부는 개인 견해라고 선을 그었습니다 (MBC 뉴스).

참고로 검색 결과는 언론사별 요약과 주간 정리에서 가져온 것이라, 세부 수치는 원문 기사로 한 번 더 확인하시는 것을 권합니다. 특정 분야(증시, 정치, 정책 등)를 더 깊이 알고 싶으시면 말씀해 주세요.

특검이 2심에서 윤석열 전 대통령에게 1심과 같은 징역 30년을 구형했습니다. 다만 여인형 전 방첩사령관의 구형량은 보도마다 다르게 나옵니다.

The Justice Ministry apologised after a man wearing an electronic ankle monitor stabbed people at a shopping centre in Incheon on Tuesday, 13 October 2026.

**The attack:** Reports say a 59-year-old man stabbed at least eight people at the mall. The attack occurred around 1.40pm at a commercial complex in Guwol-dong, Namdong district, which houses a Homeplus supermarket. Bystanders stopped him. Witnesses said they trapped the man from below and subdued him near the escalator's third-floor entrance, pushing him down with chairs and removing his knives, before police arrived. One victim is in serious condition. "One woman in her twenties is in cardiac arrest, and seven other people have been injured in the incident," an official at Incheon Fire Department told AFP.

**The suspect's record:** He had been sentenced to four years in prison for attempted murder after repeatedly stabbing his ex-wife in 2015. After his release in 2019, he was ordered to wear an electronic ankle monitor for 10 years, until February 2029. Last month he was investigated by police on a weapons possession case for allegedly stabbing a protester's banner outside a hospital.

**Probation contact that day:** The suspect attended a counselling session from 10 to 11 a.m. and then met his probation officer from 11:20 to 11:55 a.m., the ministry said. The officer confirmed that the suspect had taken his medication and had lunch with him until 12:30.

**The ministry's response:** The ministry said it apologised publicly, acknowledging the monitoring system failed to prevent the attack. Its statement said "We deeply apologize for causing great concern to the public over today's knife attack in Incheon involving an individual subject to electronic monitoring." It also said it was conducting a "thorough investigation into the circumstances of the incident and the entire electronic monitoring and supervision process". The review will cover his supervision, treatment and risk assessment, and a review of electronic monitoring and parole management. On the device itself, the ministry said there had been no attempt to damage the monitoring device and no breach of its conditions connected with the attack.

**Government reaction:** President Lee Jae-myung, visiting an Incheon police agency, demanded a swift and thorough investigation and wished the injured a speedy recovery. Acting National Police Agency chief Kim Jong-chul also instructed regional police departments to strengthen preventive measures in crowded public places by deploying sufficient officers.

Casualty figures differ slightly between outlets. Some say eight people were stabbed, while AFP's count is one in cardiac arrest and seven others wounded. Investigators were still working on the suspect's motive when these reports were published.

The search turned up several reports from October 12–15, 2026, of sharp KOSPI declines driven by chip stocks. The reports disagree on the exact figures.

**October 13 (Tuesday):** AP reported the index was down 7.4% to 5,914.35, its lowest level since late July. Other outlets put the close lower. Crypto Briefing said the index fell as much as 7% intraday before closing down approximately 5.5%, and Forklog gave a 5.46% fall to 6035.35 points. Samsung and SK Hynix led the losses. AP noted that Samsung Electronics fell 7.7%, while memory chipmaker SK Hynix plunged 8.8%.

**Causes:** Reports point to several factors. Forklog said investors sold off shares of chip manufacturers due to concerns over increasing competition in the semiconductor industry and the sustainability of the AI boom. On the US side, Crypto Briefing reported that recent US consumer price index data showed inflation running faster than expected, which shifted thinking around the possibility of rate hikes. It also cited weakness in CoreWeave's bonds raised specific worries about how AI infrastructure is being funded.

**October 15 (Thursday):** Gulf News reported that the Kospi index plunged 8% on Thursday as a worldwide rout in semiconductor shares pushed investors to abandon the most crowded AI trades. The Seoul exchange halted trading for 20 minutes as losses mounted. Korea Economic Daily reported an early-session drop of KOSPI (5641.71, -6.11%), and said the sell-side circuit breakers (sidecars) were triggered for the KOSPI and KOSDAQ. Its explanation was the higher-than-expected US September CPI (3.7% vs. forecast 3.6%).

**Discrepancy to note:** An Outlook Business article reported that the KOSPI fell 724.37 points, or 10.73%, to 6,031.38, prompting a 20-minute trading halt. It describes this as a Tuesday move, but its index level and the surrounding context don't match the October 13 close reported elsewhere, so its date is unclear. I'd treat that figure as unverified until you check a primary source such as the Korea Exchange.

**Background:** The index had already fallen sharply earlier in the year. Forklog reported that on July 28-29, KOSPI fell by 16%. At that time, investors doubted the profitability of AI infrastructure and feared increased competition in memory production. Foreign selling was also heavy: according to Forklog, from October 2 to 12, foreign investors sold South Korean stocks worth 8.46 trillion won.

For exact closing levels and daily percentages, I'd check the Korea Exchange or Yonhap, since these secondary reports differ.
